steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Planka at http://127.0.0.1:8104/ using email admin@example.com and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify that the authenticated app is open.
02-open: On project Bench Project, open board Bench Board and report the exact names of all cards whose names start with Seed:, confirming these are the Seed cards in To Do. Do not edit any cards.

03-create: On board Bench Board, create a card named exactly '{{runid}} Bench Card' in the 'In Progress' list. Set its description to one paragraph that includes '{{runid}}', saving the description once without duplicate paragraph. Open the card's own view and report its address ID and verify its name, list, and saved description.

04-open: For the open card '{{runid}} Bench Card', set its only label to the existing exact label 'Hardware'. Ensure no other labels are attached and verify the card displays only Hardware; do not create a label.

05-set: For '{{runid}} Bench Card', set its only member to the existing exact board user 'Bench Tester'. Make sure no other member remains assigned and verify the card displays only Bench Tester; do not select Bench Tester Lead.
06-set: Set the due date of '{{runid}} Bench Card' to 2026-12-31 (any time that date is fine). Verify the saved date on the card.
07-add: From the own card view of '{{runid}} Bench Card', add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}'. Verify that the comment is posted and report its exact text.
